mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the biceps was most worthwhile because the two poses showed how a shortening muscle bends the elbow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the triceps felt a little repetitive after building the biceps, even though both were needed.

surprise.text: The different attachments make two pulling muscles turn the joint in opposite directions; the triceps doesn't have to push.

arbitrary.text: None felt particularly arbitrary: the coverings, tendons and named back-muscle slot made their purposes reasonably clear.

continue.text: Yes, I would try another chapter: seeing the assembled muscles explain opposite movements was satisfying, though I would hope for less repetition.
